core.py:13 DEFAULT_REPO hardcodes '/home/shrek/AIWorkHub' fallback; overridable via AIWORKHUB_REPO env but not submodule-neutral. README/MCP-config also hardcode this path.
aiworkhub_task_pending_for_runner maps to taskctl 'export' (dump) classified read-only; distinct string from write 'export-jsonl' so not caught by WRITE_COMMANDS by design.

source_of_truth.evidence: core.run_taskctl shells out to 'python3 AITools/taskctl.py' with cwd=repo_root (core.py:159-169); the MCP layer writes NO independent task state. Its only file write is an append-only audit log of BLOCKED write attempts (core.py:91-126), which is observability, not queue state, and lives under gitignored logs/.
